Iris (marketing): Need a fresh battlecard refresh before Thurs webinar. Priorities: succinct takedowns vs cloud AI, two econ bullets (throughput + unit cost), and an inbound-routing play.
Tom (field): Agreed. Make econ bullets measurable: "predictable throughput (tokens/s)" and "effective cost/token with caching". Add a short objection handler for 'we can DIY'.
Rae (product): For DIY rebut use: 'Buying GPUs isn't the same as running production inference: serving, KV caching, rollouts, and tracing still required.' One line.
Ned (research): I'll pull microbench numbers: unbatched p95 ~130ms, batched p95 (batch=16) ~45ms, dedicated steady throughput ~2800 t/s per card. Will include quantized vs fp16.
ops-bot: Note: Dedicated supports canary rollouts; recommended copy: 'pin model versions, safe canaries, audit logs'.
Tom (field): Inbound routing: 3 buckets -> Explore (<20k tokens), Growth (20k-200k), Enterprise (>200k or security needs). Map to: SDR trial, SDR+AE, AE+SE.
Iris (marketing): For webinar demo, propose "serving-first": live region failover + cost dashboard. Who owns slides?
Rae (product): I'll own slides; Ned send charts. Tom draft routing play (1 slide).
Tom (field): Draft routing snippet: `priority: region -> fallback: cost_tier -> model_variants: [fp16, int8]`. Will add 2-line customer anecdote (non-confidential).
Ned (research): Exporting p50/p95 CSVs now. Include quantized numbers.
Iris (marketing): Keep competitor contrast factual: 'Cloud endpoints are general-purpose; Redwood adds serving ops, predictable latency, and cost controls.' Short and provable.
Rae (product): Timeline: slides by Tue noon, playbook update Wed, final battlecard Thu AM.
Iris (marketing): Great. I'll schedule Wed 10am review. Thanks team :rocket:
